first_line: Tumi kemon kore gaan koro hey guni,
Charano dhorite diyo go aamare,    niyo
Ei kothati mone rekho,    tomader ei haa
Aami  tomar sange bnedhechhi aamar praan
Ektuku chnowa laage ektuku kotha shuni -
Je raate mor duwarguli bhaanglo jhare
Eki labonye purno praan praanesh hey,
Maajhe maajhe tabo dekha paai, chirodin
Aamar mukti aaloy aaloy ei aakashe,
Nil digante oi phuler aagun laaglo,
Aamar hiyar maajhe lukiye chhile dekhte
Ore bhaai phaagun legechhe bone bone -
O jonaki, ki sukhe oi daana duti melechh
